text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: He looks like an experienced guardsman.
source_text: He looks like an experienced guardsman.

text: 他看起来是一个很有经验的守卫。
source_text: 他看起来是一个很有经验的守卫。

text: You'd better watch yourself here.
source_text: You'd better watch yourself here.

text: 你在城里老实点。
source_text: 你在城里老实点。

text: This isn't a good town to get in trouble in.
source_text: This isn't a good town to get in trouble in.

text: 这个镇子可不是你们闹事的好地方。
source_text: 这个镇子可不是你们闹事的好地方。

text: Behave, and we won't have to get nasty.
source_text: Behave, and we won't have to get nasty.

text: 守法，我们就不会对你怎么样。
source_text: 守法，我们就不会对你怎么样。

text: You're ok.
source_text: You're ok.

text: 你可以进去了。
source_text: 你可以进去了。

text: Keep up the good work.
source_text: Keep up the good work.

text: 好好干。
source_text: 好好干。

text: Nice day, isn't it?
source_text: Nice day, isn't it?

text: 天气不错，哈？
source_text: 天气不错，哈？

text: This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on# our good side.
source_text:
This is Junktown. Nice place to live, as long as you stay on
# our good side.

text: 这里是迦克镇，很好的地方，只要你不乱来。
source_text: 这里是迦克镇，很好的地方，只要你不乱来。

text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.
source_text: Watch out for Gizmo and his cronies.

text: 小心吉斯莫和他的手下。
source_text: 小心吉斯莫和他的手下。

text: I like my boss.
source_text: I like my boss.

text: 我喜欢我的老板。
source_text: 我喜欢我的老板。

text: You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place, friend, and we# want to keep it that way.
source_text:
You'd better put that away. Junktown is a friendly place, friend, and we
# want to keep it that way.

text: 你把那个收起来。迦克镇是一个和平的地方，我们希望保持这个气氛。
source_text: 你把那个收起来。迦克镇是一个和平的地方，我们希望保持这个气氛。

text: Put what away?
source_text: Put what away?

text: 把什么收起来？
source_text: 把什么收起来？

text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.
source_text: Don't tell me what to do, loser boy.

text: 别想让我听你的话，小样。
source_text: 别想让我听你的话，小样。

text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?
source_text: Sounds fair. By the way, what is the local law regarding weapons?

text: 听起来不错。对了，本地对武器的法规是怎么样的？
source_text: 听起来不错。对了，本地对武器的法规是怎么样的？

text: Uh,oh.
source_text: Uh,oh.

text: 噢，噢。
source_text: 噢，噢。

text: Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd# better damn well keep them in your holster.
source_text:
Your weapon, idiot. Killian won't take your arms away, but you'd
# better damn well keep them in your holster.

text: 你的武器，白痴。基利安不会没收你的武器，但你必须把它们收好。
source_text: 你的武器，白痴。基利安不会没收你的武器，但你必须把它们收好。

text: Oh, sorry.
source_text: Oh, sorry.

text: 哦，对不起。
source_text: 哦，对不起。

text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!
source_text: No way! I'm not putting down my shooters for nobody!

text: 没门！我不会让任何人缴我的枪！
source_text: 没门！我不会让任何人缴我的枪！

text: You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law.# Put your weapon away, don't draw it unless in self-defense, and# you won't have a problem with us guards. Disobey the law, and we# will return you to the lawless wasteland - dead or alive.
source_text:
You'd better behave, since it's the law, and I enforce the law.
# Put your weapon away, don't draw it unless in self-defense, and
# you won't have a problem with us guards. Disobey the law, and we
# will return you to the lawless wasteland - dead or alive.

text: 你最好遵照执行，这是法律，我是执法者。把你的武器收起来，除非自卫，不能再拿出来，我们守卫就不会再来麻烦你。如果你想违反法律，那我们就送你回废土去，不管你的死活。
source_text: 你最好遵照执行，这是法律，我是执法者。把你的武器收起来，除非自卫，不能再拿出来，我们守卫就不会再来麻烦你。如果你想违反法律，那我们就送你回废土去，不管你的死活。

text: Sure, since you put it that way.
source_text: Sure, since you put it that way.

text: 好吧，既然你这么说的话。
source_text: 好吧，既然你这么说的话。

text: Bite your laws!
source_text: Bite your laws!

text: 滚蛋吧，破法律！
source_text: 滚蛋吧，破法律！

text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.
source_text: Well, uh, fine with me. But you'd better be careful.

text: 好，我接受，但你要小心点。
source_text: 好，我接受，但你要小心点。

text: Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If# you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your right# to go around armed. Just don't pull a knife or gun without just# cause. Have a good day.
source_text:
Good you asked. No weapons can be drawn except in self-defense. If
# you start a fight, it's your fault. Other than that, it's your right
# to go around armed. Just don't pull a knife or gun without just
# cause. Have a good day.

text: 很好。除了自卫，不准拿出武器来。你如果首先挑起战斗，那是你的错。记住这些，你可以携带武器四处转悠。但是没有正当理由不能动刀枪。再见。
source_text: 很好。除了自卫，不准拿出武器来。你如果首先挑起战斗，那是你的错。记住这些，你可以携带武器四处转悠。但是没有正当理由不能动刀枪。再见。

text: Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on# your head as a kid. No weapons.
source_text:
Hey you, no weapons! And I don't care if your momma dropped you on
# your head as a kid. No weapons.

text: 嘿！你站住！不准拿出武器！你妈妈生你的时候让你脑袋砸在地上了？不准拿出武器！
source_text: 嘿！你站住！不准拿出武器！你妈妈生你的时候让你脑袋砸在地上了？不准拿出武器！

text: Hey! You! What are you doing sneaking around?
source_text: Hey! You! What are you doing sneaking around?

text: 嘿！你！你鬼鬼祟祟干什么？
source_text: 嘿！你！你鬼鬼祟祟干什么？

text: Nothing.
source_text: Nothing.

text: 没事。
source_text: 没事。

text: I'm not sneaking around. I just like to walk cautiously.
source_text: I'm not sneaking around. I just like to walk cautiously.

text: 我不是鬼鬼祟祟，我是小心地在走路。
source_text: 我不是鬼鬼祟祟，我是小心地在走路。

text: Uhhh.
source_text: Uhhh.

text: 唔。
source_text: 唔。

text: Whatever you're doing, don't do it in this town.
source_text: Whatever you're doing, don't do it in this town.

text: 我不管你想干什么，在城里不准这样。
source_text: 我不管你想干什么，在城里不准这样。

text: The guard stares at you for a moment. You see a look of recognition# on his face, and then he pulls his weapon.
source_text:
The guard stares at you for a moment. You see a look of recognition
# on his face, and then he pulls his weapon.

text: 【守卫瞪了你一阵子，似乎认出了你，掏出了武器。】
source_text: 【守卫瞪了你一阵子，似乎认出了你，掏出了武器。】

text: Well, uh, ok. Whatever. Just don't do anything out of line.
source_text: Well, uh, ok. Whatever. Just don't do anything out of line.

text: 呃，好，不管怎样，别做出格的事情。
source_text: 呃，好，不管怎样，别做出格的事情。

text: Thanks, bye.
source_text: Thanks, bye.

text: 多谢，再见。
source_text: 多谢，再见。

text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, sir.
source_text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, sir.

text: 当然，我时时刻刻都很小心的。
source_text: 当然，我时时刻刻都很小心的。

text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, ma'am.
source_text: Certainly. I will throw caution to the wind, ma'am.

text: 当然，我时时刻刻都很小心的。
source_text: 当然，我时时刻刻都很小心的。

text: Put that weapon away, or face the consequences!
source_text: Put that weapon away, or face the consequences!

text: 把武器收起来，否则你不会有好日子过！
source_text: 把武器收起来，否则你不会有好日子过！

text: Okay, that's enough warnings. Leave town, now, and never return, or# face the consequences!
source_text:
Okay, that's enough warnings. Leave town, now, and never return, or
# face the consequences!

text: 我们给了你很多警告了。离开镇子，不准回来，不然有你好看！
source_text: 我们给了你很多警告了。离开镇子，不准回来，不然有你好看！

text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
source_text: Hey! What do you think you're doing?

text: 嘿！你在做什么？
source_text: 嘿！你在做什么？

text: That's it, you've had it, buddy.
source_text: That's it, you've had it, buddy.

text: 好的，你自找的。
source_text: 好的，你自找的。

text: You're in trouble now . . .
source_text: You're in trouble now . . .

text: 你有麻烦了……
source_text: 你有麻烦了……

text: You Skulz are under arrest!
source_text: You Skulz are under arrest!

text: 你们骷髅党都被逮捕了！
source_text: 你们骷髅党都被逮捕了！
